text: This is a cup of coffee.
But it began as the seed of a fruit.
Coffee cherries ripen on the branch, from green to red.
Cut one open: two seeds, face to face.
The cherries dry whole in the sun, then the husk comes off.
asr: The cherries dry hole in the sun, then the husk comes off.

text: Green beans. Nothing like coffee yet.
Near one hundred ninety-six degrees, they crack, like popcorn.
asr: Near 196 degrees, they crack, like popcorn.

text: Ground, and met with hot water,
the seed of a cherry becomes a cup of coffee.
